summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting to approve a capital reorganisation — a par-value reduction from HK$0.10 to HK$0.000001 per share, followed by a share subdivision. This is a routine corporate housekeeping item to eliminate accumulated losses and create distributable reserves, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is involved. The meeting and resolutions are standard and non-eventful.
